title: Compiled machine initial configuration
statement: Let $P$ be a register program, $D$ a deterministic multi-tape machine, $l_0$ a program state, and $q_0$ a map assigning a state of $D$ to each decider index. For every Boolean input word $x$, the compiled machine's initial configuration on $x$ equals the seam formed from the initial configuration of $P$ on $x$ with start state $l_0$.
hypotheses_covered: A map $q_0$ from decider indices to states of $D$
